jobs.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : SAP for Banking Good to have skills: NA Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification: 15 years full time education We are looking for experienced SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking professionals to join our banking transformation programme. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience working on SAP Banking solutions within the banking domain, preferably across implementation, configuration, integration, migration or production support engagements. SAP Core Banking is an industry-specific solution for banking clients, with key capabilities across Deposits Management, Business Partner, Loans Management and Payments. Candidates with experience in one or more of these areas are encouraged to apply, with preference given to candidates who have worked across multiple SAP Banking modules and have strong banking domain knowledge. Key SAP Banking Areas The candidate should have experience in one or more of the following: 1. Deposits Management (DM) Current Accounts and Savings Accounts Term/Time Deposits Banking product configuration Account opening and lifecycle management Interest calculation and processing Charges, fees and related account operations Deposit product migration and conversion Integration with Business Partner and Payments 2. Business Partner (FS-BP) SAP Financial Services Business Partner Customer / Business Partner creation and maintenance Business Partner roles and relationships Customer data migration BP integration with Deposits, Loans and Payments Understanding of customer lifecycle processes 3. Loans Management (LM) Retail/Commercial lending products Loan account lifecycle Loan creation and disbursement Repayment and payment schedules Interest and charges Loan closure/payoff Loan product configuration and migration Integration with Payments and Business Partner 4. Payments / Payment Central / Payment Engine Payment processing and payment lifecycle Payment initiation and processing Payment routing and distribution Payment exceptions and investigation Payment-related configuration Integration with core banking and external payment systems Understanding of domestic/international payment flows Key Responsibilities Work with business and technology teams to understand banking requirements and translate them into SAP Banking solutions. Configure and support SAP Core Banking functionality based on business requirements. Participate in end-to-end SAP Banking implementation and transformation programmes. Support product configuration across Deposits, Loans, Business Partner and Payments. Analyse existing legacy banking processes and support their migration to SAP. Support data migration, reconciliation and validation activities. Work on integration between SAP Banking modules and external banking applications. Analyse and resolve functional issues, defects and production incidents. Support SIT, UAT, regression testing and production deployment activities. Work closely with technical teams on interfaces, APIs, integrations and batch processing. Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, test scenarios and operational documentation. Participate in design discussions and provide banking domain expertise. Support release planning, implementation and post-go-live activities. Collaborate with distributed teams across business, technology, vendors and banking stakeholders. Required Skills Must Have: Hands-on experience in SAP Banking / SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking. Strong understanding of banking products and processes. Experience in at least one of the following: Deposits Management Loans Management Business Partner / FS-BP Payments / Payment Engine / Payment Central Experience in SAP Banking implementation, migration, configuration or production support. Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking components. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work with business and technology stakeholders. Preferred Skills Candidates with experience across two or more of the following will be preferred: SAP Deposits Management SAP Loans Management SAP Financial Services Business Partner SAP Payment Engine / Payments SAP Transactional Banking / TRBK SAP Banking Services Banking product configuration Legacy-to-SAP banking migration Large-scale banking transformation programmes Retail Banking / Corporate Banking Account and customer migration Banking payments and settlement processes Banking Domain Experience Candidates should have a good understanding of one or more of the following banking processes: Current and Savings Accounts Term Deposits Customer / Business Partner lifecycle Loans and lending products Account opening and closure Interest and fee processing Payments and payment processing Account migration Customer migration Product migration Banking reconciliation Payment exceptions and investigations Integration & Technical Exposure Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking and surrounding systems is desirable. Exposure to the following would be advantageous: APIs / Web Services REST / SOAP Enterprise integration Banking middleware Batch processing Data migration tools Database / SQL SAP integration frameworks Legacy banking platforms Payment systems Experience in Transformation / Migration Experience in large-scale banking transformation programmes will be highly valuable, particularly: Legacy banking platform SAP migration Customer and account migration Deposit product migration Loan migration Payment migration Data reconciliation and validation Application decommissioning Parallel run / cutover Production deployment and hypercare Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a SAP Banking specialist with strong banking domain knowledge, rather than a generic SAP consultant. Qualification 15 years full time education 5-10 Yrs DNS, Commercial, Processing, Migration, Banking Product, Lending, Data, Corporate banking

Experience with PL/SQL, including packages, procedures, functions, and complex queries for data management and reporting use cases. Experience with SSO/authentication technologies, such as Auth0 or similar identity platforms. Experience with MuleSoft or similar enterprise integration platforms. Experience with Salesforce development and enterprise integrations, including Salesforce APIs, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and integration between Salesforce and backend services. Experience working in an international Agile delivery team. 5-10 Yrs Boot, Oracle, Spring Boot, SQL, Bootstrap, Debugging, DBMS, Jwt

jobs.description: About the Role: The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at EaseMyTrip.com will be responsible for defining and leading the overall technology vision and execution for one of Indias largest online travel platforms. This role involves overseeing the full spectrum of engineering from backend system design and frontend development to Generative AI integration and large-scale cloud infrastructure. Backend & System Design: Proven ability to architect large-scale, secure systems and RESTful APIs with focus on modularity and maintainability. Frontend Development: Proficient in Angular, TypeScript, and responsive design with a strong focus on user experience and SEO best practices. Database Knowledge: Expertise in SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and schema performance optimization. Cloud & DevOps: Experienced with AWS/GCP/Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and serverless deployments. Security Knowledge: Strong grasp of encryption, application security, and secure SDLC principles. Leadership & Collaboration: Effective communicator with a track record of mentoring and leading diverse technology teams in fast-paced environments. Innovation Mindset: Passionate about emerging technologies, problem-solving, and building AI-first travel experiences. 10-20 Yrs Python, generative ai, Artificial Intelligence, ASP.NET Core, Chatgpt, Angularjs, Web API, .NET Core
